title: Mixed Sizes Without Cropping
tests: Checks consistent vertical composition of landscape, square and portrait photos without cropping or distortion.

judge.summary: The visible frames show a clean, silent vertical photo reel with soft blurred fill, but the supplied samples do not establish whether the pastries photo appears.

must_haves.item: One silent 9:16 reel runs for approximately 10 seconds with no added text.
must_haves.why: The output is a single 10-second vertical clip with 9:16 framing, reported silent audio, and no visible added text.

must_haves.item: All five supplied photos appear in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The samples show storefront, latte, barista, and interior in the correct relative order; the pastries photo could appear between samples but is not shown.

must_haves.item: The landscape storefront, barista and interior photos retain their complete image boundaries.
must_haves.why: The storefront matches the complete supplied image. Barista and interior appear fitted as landscape images, but their source attachments are not shown for boundary comparison.

must_haves.item: The square latte and vertical pastries photos also remain fully visible, without cropping.
must_haves.why: The latte retains the complete square source image, but no output sample shows the pastries photo.

must_haves.item: Every foreground photo retains its original proportions, with no stretching or squashing.
must_haves.why: Storefront and latte preserve their source proportions, and the other visible photos show no obvious distortion; pastries is not visible and the remaining originals are unavailable for comparison.

must_haves.item: Unused canvas around fitted photos is filled with a soft blurred background rather than plain bars.
must_haves.why: All shown output frames use soft, image-derived blurred backgrounds above and below the foreground photos.

case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Gardener Interview Name Caption
tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

faults.what: The required dark backing behind the lower third is missing. White lettering sits directly over the garden and her light shirt, reducing contrast as she moves.

judge.summary: The woman smiles and turns toward the camera in a garden with correctly spelled lower-third text, but the required dark caption backing is missing.

must_haves.item: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
must_haves.why: The frames show a smiling woman turning from profile toward the camera among planted beds and garden supports.

must_haves.item: The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
must_haves.why: Both lines read exactly as requested, in the correct order, with no other visible text.

must_haves.item: Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
must_haves.why: The white text is at the bottom left and is not clipped, but there is no visible dark backing.

must_haves.item: The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
must_haves.why: The text stays in the same position below her face and remains readable in the supplied frames, though contrast decreases over her shirt.

must_haves.item: The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
must_haves.why: It is absent at 0.9 seconds and present at 2.7, 4.6, and 6.4 seconds, consistent with the requested timing in the available samples.

must_haves.item: The delivered clip is silent, 16:9 and approximately 7 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are widescreen approximately 16:9 and the supplied duration is 7.3 seconds, but silence cannot be verified from still images.

title: Kitchen Renovation Side by Side
tests: Composes two supplied photos into one correctly ordered, clearly labeled comparison without regenerating either scene.

judge.summary: The finished 16:9 comparison neatly displays both complete, unchanged kitchen photos side by side with clear, correct labels.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image contains both supplied kitchen photos side by side.
must_haves.why: The landscape output has a 16:9 aspect ratio and includes both photos in adjacent panels.

must_haves.item: The brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and the white-cabinet renovated kitchen is on the right.
must_haves.why: The original brown kitchen appears on the left and the renovated white kitchen on the right.

must_haves.item: The left panel is labeled exactly 'Before' and the right panel exactly 'After', with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: Both labels are correctly spelled, clearly readable, and fully visible above their respective photos.

must_haves.item: Both complete photos remain visible without stretching or changes to their contents.
must_haves.why: Both photos retain their full framing and original proportions, with no visible content alterations.

title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots
tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

faults.what: The sampled frames show a basic slideshow-style presentation with blurred screenshot side fills and little visible motion, making the visual treatment less energetic than requested.

judge.summary: A clean, basic widescreen ad shows both readable screenshots in the correct order and ends with a clear FitTrack title, though the visuals lack energy.

must_haves.item: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 10 seconds, and the output frames are landscape 16:9.

must_haves.item: The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
must_haves.why: The home screen appears at 1.3 and 3.8 seconds, followed by the workout screen at 6.3 seconds.

must_haves.item: Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
must_haves.why: Both screenshots retain their supplied layouts, labels, and values, with readable text and no visible replacement UI.

must_haves.item: The ending clearly displays 'FitTrack'.
must_haves.why: The 8.8-second frame displays a large, clear FitTrack title on white.

must_haves.item: An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The sound report confirms audio and no clear speech, but does not establish whether the audio is an upbeat instrumental track.
